description: Topology and motif analysis of Kv8.2: selectivity filter, S4 voltage sensor, and hydropathy-based TM count
code:
import requests, re
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fasta = requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q8TDN2.fasta", timeout=25).text
seq = "".join(fasta.splitlines()[1:])
print("Length:", len(seq), "aa")

# 1) K+ selectivity filter signature T-x-G-[YF]-G
for m in re.finditer(r'T.G[YF]G', seq):
    print("Selectivity filter signature:", m.group(), "at residues", m.start()+1, "-", m.end())
    print("  context:", seq[m.start()-6:m.end()+6])

# 2) Voltage-sensor S4: segment with periodic basic residues
s4 = re.search(r'[LIVF]R[A-Z]{2}[RK][A-Z]{2}[RK][A-Z]{2}[RK]', seq)
if s4:
    print("\nCandidate S4 voltage sensor:", s4.group(), "at", s4.start()+1)
# show the known S4-ish region
idx = seq.find("LRVMRLMRIFRILKLAR")
print("S4 region 'LRVMRLMRIFRILKLAR' found at residue:", idx+1 if idx>=0 else "not exact")

# 3) Kyte-Doolittle hydropathy to visualize ~6 TM helices
kd = {'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,
      'H':-3.2,'I':4.5,'L':3.8,'K':-3.9,'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,
      'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2}
w=19
h=[np.mean([kd[a] for a in seq[i:i+w]]) for i in range(len(seq)-w+1)]
x=np.arange(len(h))+w//2
plt.figure(figsize=(11,4))
plt.plot(x,h,lw=1)
plt.axhline(1.6,color='r',ls='--',lw=0.8,label='TM threshold (1.6)')
plt.axhline(0,color='grey',lw=0.5)
# mark filter
fm=re.search(r'T.G[YF]G',seq)
plt.axvline(fm.start()+1,color='green',ls=':',label='selectivity filter')
plt.title("Kv8.2 (Q8TDN2) Kyte-Doolittle hydropathy — transmembrane core ~residues 230-470")
plt.xlabel("Residue"); plt.ylabel("Hydropathy (window=19)"); plt.legend(fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig("kv8.2_hydropathy.png",dpi=120)
n_tm=0; above=False
for val in h:
    if val>1.6 and not above: n_tm+=1; above=True
    elif val<1.6: above=False
print("\nApprox TM-crossing peaks above 1.6:", n_tm)
print("N-terminal cytoplasmic T1/BTB domain spans roughly residues ~100-230 (before first TM)")
